description: ArduPilot 滤波器调参知识库 — FFT 分析与陷波滤波器规则

levels.implication: No filter needed. Ready for aggressive PID tuning.
levels.action: Default filter settings sufficient. Proceed to PID tuning.

levels.implication: Acceptable. Some noise visible in logs.
levels.action: Enable harmonic notch (INS_HNTCH_HMC=1). Use GYRO_FILTER per prop size default.

levels.implication: May cause position/altitude hold issues. Visible vibration in flight.
levels.action: Mechanical inspection recommended. FFT analysis + notch filter. Lower GYRO_FILTER by 1 step.

levels.implication: Position hold unreliable. Altitude hold degraded. Possible EKF failures.
levels.action: Do NOT fly in auto modes until resolved. Check: prop balance, motor mounts, frame rigidity, IMU dampening.

levels.implication: IMU saturation likely. EKF will fail. Possible motor/ESC damage over time.
levels.action: Ground the vehicle immediately. Mechanical fix mandatory before flight.

characteristics: main peak at motor fundamental frequency
peaks shift with throttle (ESC telemetry mode) or stay fixed (static mode)
motor_noise.fft_signature: sharp, narrow peak — mechanical rotor frequency

characteristics: often 2nd or 3rd harmonic of motor freq
propeller_blade_pass.fft_signature: broader peak, may have multiple blade harmonics

structural_resonance.frequency_formula: no fixed formula — identified from flight data
characteristics: frame/arm resonance, often excited by specific throttle range
can shift with battery voltage, payload
usually a single dominant peak that grows with throttle
structural_resonance.fft_signature: sudden spike at specific throttle, may be intermittent

motor_bearing_wear.fft_signature: elevated noise floor + sidebands, not sharp peaks

primary_peak_identification.step1: Find the highest magnitude peak in FFT spectrum
primary_peak_identification.step2: Verify it is motor-related (check harmonics at 2x, 3x exist)
primary_peak_identification.step3: Confirm with throttle test: peak shifts with RPM in dynamic mode, fixed in static
primary_peak_identification.step4: If multiple peaks of similar magnitude, rank by: amplitude > sharpness > throttle correlation

decision.2nd_highest_peak: Consider 2nd harmonic notch or INS_HNTCH_OPTS bit1 tracking
decision.noise_floor_elevated: Structural issue — not filterable, needs mechanical fix

2_peaks_different_sources.example: motor peak at 120Hz + prop blade pass at 240Hz
2_peaks_different_sources.action: Set INS_HNTCH_FREQ = lower freq (120Hz), enable harmonics (INS_HNTCH_HMC = 1) to cover 240Hz, 360Hz
2_peaks_different_sources.fallback: If harmonics insufficient, use INS_HNTC2_* for 2nd independent notch

2_peaks_same_source_different_freq.example: two motors at different RPM (asymmetric prop wear)
2_peaks_same_source_different_freq.action: Use ESC telemetry mode (INS_HNTCH_MODE = 3) for per-motor tracking, or set INS_HNTCH_FREQ = lower, INS_HNTC2_FREQ = higher

3_plus_significant_peaks.action: Use FFT-based tracking mode (INS_HNTCH_MODE = 4), set INS_HNTCH_OPTS bit1 to auto-track 3 largest peaks
3_plus_significant_peaks.constraint: CPU warning — max 3 harmonics total across all notches on most boards

broad_elevated_region.action: Likely structural resonance. Use static notch at center of region with wider BW (BW = FREQ/2). May need mechanical damping.
broad_elevated_region.do_not: Never use FFT-tracking mode for broadband noise — it will try to track noise instead of signal

mode_meanings.1: Fixed frequency static notch (INS_HNTCH_FREQ is fixed, does not track RPM)
mode_meanings.2: Throttle-based dynamic notch (FREQ scales with throttle: FREQ = REF * sqrt(throttle/hover_throttle))
mode_meanings.3: ESC telemetry dynamic notch (FREQ from motor RPM telemetry, most accurate for multirotor)
mode_meanings.4: FFT-based tracking (uses in-flight FFT analysis to find and track noise peaks)

mode_selection_table.scenario: Complex vibration with multiple sources, good CPU margin
Traditional helicopter with known rotor speed

notch_mode_selection.mode_4_cpu_warning: FFT tracking mode (4) can consume significant CPU. Test with HCAL enabled. On F7/H7 MCUs: OK for 1 notch + 2 harmonics. On older boards: reduce harmonics or use mode 2/3.

INS_HNTCH_FREQ.throttle_mode_formula: FREQ = hover_freq (at setup hover throttle), filter dynamically scales from this reference
INS_HNTCH_FREQ.esc_telem_mode_formula: FREQ = below_hover_freq (telemetry provides actual RPM, filter tracks directly)
INS_HNTCH_FREQ.fft_tracking_mode: Auto-set from FFT analysis, or manually override to measured peak
INS_HNTCH_FREQ.constraint: Must be > 0. Never round UP — round to nearest integer below measured peak if uncertain (safer to slightly under-target than over-target).

INS_HNTCH_BW.description: 陷波带宽 (Hz) — 滤波器在 -3dB 点的宽度
INS_HNTCH_BW.narrow_formula: BW = FREQ / 4 (use when: motor noise is very sharp/spectral, CPU constrained, or many harmonics enabled)
INS_HNTCH_BW.wide_formula: BW = FREQ * 0.8 (use when: structural resonance causes broad elevated region, or multiple close peaks)
INS_HNTCH_BW.helicopter_formula: BW = 10 (fixed, traditional helicopters have very stable rotor freq)
INS_HNTCH_BW.harmonic_notch_rule: When INS_HNTCH_HMC = 1, harmonics share proportional BW (each harmonic BW = fundamental_BW * harmonic_number)

INS_HNTCH_ATT.description: 陷波衰减深度 (dB) — 值越大陷波越深

practical_values.40: Standard — good noise reduction, minimal phase impact
practical_values.60: Aggressive — use if residual noise still high after filter
practical_values.80: Maximum — use with caution; very deep notch can cause phase distortion
practical_values.20: Conservative — use when notch is near control bandwidth (e.g. 5" props at low RPM)

INS_HNTCH_ATT.phase_impact: ATT越高 → 相位延迟越大 → 对 PID 相位裕度影响增大
INS_HNTCH_ATT.warning: ATT > 80 can cause control issues on frames with marginal stiffness. Monitor for oscillation after filter enable.

INS_HNTCH_REF.description: 参考频率值 — 用于 throttle-based 和 FFT-based 模式的缩放基准
INS_HNTCH_REF.meaning: When throttle = hover, filter center = REF. As throttle varies, center freq scales as sqrt(throttle/hover_throttle).
INS_HNTCH_REF.fft_mode_usage: REF = measured noise frequency at hover throttle
INS_HNTCH_REF.static_mode_usage: REF can be left at 0 (not used)

INS_HNTCH_HMC.description: 谐波开关 — 是否启用谐波陷波
INS_HNTCH_HMC.1: Enabled — notch at fundamental + harmonics 2x, 3x (and 4x if INS_HNTC3 used)
INS_HNTCH_HMC.recommendation: Almost always set to 1 for multirotor. Motor noise has significant harmonic content.
INS_HNTCH_HMC.harmonic_count: Up to 3 harmonics auto-generated (FREQ*2, FREQ*3, FREQ*4). Each harmonic BW scales proportionally.

below_5inch.reason: High RPM motors generate noise up to 200Hz+

adjustment_rules.condition: FFT shows noise peaks well attenuated by notch, noise floor clean
adjustment_rules.action: Increase GYRO_FILTER by 1 step (20 to 40, 40 to 60, 60 to 80)
adjustment_rules.monitor: Motor temperature, audio for high-pitched noise, flight feel

adjustment_rules.condition: Gyro FFT shows significant noise above 200Hz leaking through
adjustment_rules.action: Lower GYRO_FILTER by 1 step, or add 2nd harmonic notch
adjustment_rules.do_not: Never just keep lowering gyro filter — this introduces phase lag that limits PID performance

adjustment_rules.condition: PID oscillates after notch filter enabled
adjustment_rules.action: Notch not deep enough OR gyro filter too high. Raise ATT to 60 or lower gyro filter.
adjustment_rules.check: Verify by temporarily raising gyro filter to 20Hz and retesting

adjustment_rules.condition: Notch filter enabled but attitude estimate drifts
adjustment_rules.action: Check INS_ACCEL_FILTER (default 10Hz). If too low, position estimate suffers. Raise to 20Hz.

gyro_filter_tuning_table.PID_phase_margin_note: 每将GYRO_FILTER提高一档(~+20Hz), 相位延迟减少约3-5度, 可略微提高 PID D gain. 但收益递减, 不要过度调高GYRO_FILTER来代替陷波.

gyro_filter_relationship.core_principle: Gyro lowpass filter cutoff freq up → phase delay down → 可用PID增益 up. 但同时噪声 up → 可能触发电机抖动或自激.

tradeoff.cutoff_too_low: 相位延迟过大 → PID响应变慢 → 姿态追踪差 → 飞行手感肉
tradeoff.cutoff_too_high: 噪声泄漏过多 → PID对振动误响应 → 电机发热增加 → 可能姿态发散
tradeoff.notch_then_gyro: 陷波滤波器降低motor noise后 → 可提高GYRO_FILTER → 可用更高PID增益 → 更好的姿态控制

accel_filter.purpose: 加速度计低通 — EKF位置估计的前置滤波
accel_filter.critical_note: 此滤波器直接影响 EKF 对位置的估计（EKF 在加速度计路径上）。设太低 → 位置跳变/漂移。设太高 → 振动进入EKF。
accel_filter.tuning: If position hold (Loiter/POSITION) is stable, leave at 10-20. If EKF complains about innovation (large position error), try raising to 20Hz.
accel_filter.do_not_confuse_with_gyro: 不要与INS_GYRO_FILTER混淆 — 陀螺仪走内环(姿态控制), 加速度计走外环(位置估计), 各独立调

FREQ.rule: FREQ within expected range for platform

BW.error: BW too narrow may cause numerical instability

BW.warn: BW wider than 2x FREQ is unusual

BW.rule: BW = FREQ/2 for typical motor noise
BW.note: BW = FREQ/4 if sharp peaks; BW = FREQ for broad noise

ATT.rule: ATT >= 40 if vibration level is MARGINAL or above
ATT.recommendation: Deep notch needed for stronger attenuation

HMC.rule: HMC=1 for multirotor with harmonic content
HMC=0 for fixed-frequency sources without harmonics

residual_vibration_check.method: Compare pre-filter and post-filter FFT from IMU batch sampler (post-filter log)
pass_criteria: Primary motor peak amplitude reduced by >= 20dB
No new peaks introduced by filter (check for aliasing artifacts)
Gyro noise floor < 10dB above baseline above 50Hz
partial_pass: Peak reduced by 10-20dB: notch BW may be too narrow or ATT too low — increase ATT to 60
Peak reduced by < 10dB: check FREQ is correctly set to peak center, check HMC enabled for harmonics
fail_criteria: Peak not reduced: notch FREQ does not match peak freq — remeasure FFT
Noise floor elevated: GYRO_FILTER too high — lower by 1 step
New peaks appear: filter is unstable or BW too wide — reduce BW or ATT

flight_test_checklist.motor_temperature: Not significantly hotter than pre-filter baseline (< 5C increase acceptable)
flight_test_checklist.audio: No new high-pitched noise from motors
flight_test_checklist.flight_feel: No oscillation or jitter in Stabilize. Smooth throttle response.
flight_test_checklist.position_hold: Loiter/PosHold stable for >= 30 seconds without drift correction spikes

vibration_level_branch.next: Proceed to PID tuning. If FFT shows peaks, still recommend notch.

vibration_level_branch.action: Enable harmonic notch. FFT analysis to find primary peak, set INS_HNTCH_FREQ. BW=FREQ/2, ATT=40, HMC=1. Set GYRO_FILTER per prop size.

Mechanical inspection + notch. Check if FFT has single clear peak: YES -> static/tracking notch; NO -> check prop balance, motor mount, frame rigidity. Lower GYRO_FILTER 1 step. Raise ATT to 60. For multi-peak: mode 4 or INS_HNTC2.

Do NOT fly in auto modes. Mandatory mechanical fix checklist: [ ] prop balance, [ ] motor dampening, [ ] arm tightening/frame crack, [ ] IMU dampening, [ ] battery/load mounting. Re-test vibration after fix before filter tuning.

fft_peak_branch.condition: FFT shows single peak, within prop size frequency range
fft_peak_branch.action: Mode 1 (static) or mode 2/3. FREQ=peak_freq, BW=FREQ/2, HMC=1. Check harmonics (2x, 3x) -> enable HMC.

fft_peak_branch.result: Mixed frequency noise or asymmetric motors
fft_peak_branch.action: With ESC telemetry: mode 3 (per-motor). Without: INS_HNTCH_FREQ=lowest_peak, INS_HNTC2_FREQ=second_peak. With 3+ peaks: mode 4 + HNTC2.

fft_peak_branch.condition: FFT shows broadband elevation (no clear peak)
fft_peak_branch.action: Mechanical solution preferred. Temporary: static notch at region center, wider BW (BW=FREQ/2). GYRO_FILTER lowered 2 steps. Warning: wide notch affects control bandwidth.

post_filter_validation_branch.partial: Raise ATT to 60, or slightly increase BW.

post_filter_validation_branch.yes: GYRO_FILTER too high. Lower by 1 step.
ATT > 60 or BW too wide. Reduce.

practical_parameter_decision_table.notes: Motor fundamental at 120Hz, e.g. 10" props at ~1800 ERPM
With ESC telemetry, auto-tracks actual RPM
FFT mode finds and tracks peaks dynamically
Traditional helicopter main rotor (mechanically stable freq)

fft_amplitude_threshold.noise_peak_above_this: 30 dB above noise floor = significant noise source
fft_amplitude_threshold.post_filter_check: After notch enabled, primary peak should be reduced by >= 20dB
